title: My brother and me
instructions: Leo kendisini ikiz kardeşiyle karşılaştırıyor. Hangi bilginin kime ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: I have a twin brother. His name is Luca. We are fourteen.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: We look the same, but we are very different.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: I get up early, but Luca loves sleeping. He gets up at eleven at the weekend!

script.speaker: leo
script.text: I like sport. I play basketball three times a week. Luca doesn't like sport. He likes music and plays the guitar.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: My favourite food is pizza. Luca is a vegetarian, so he doesn't eat meat.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: At school, I am good at maths, and Luca is good at English and art.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: We are different, but he is my best friend.

questions.prompt: How old are Leo and Luca?
questions.feedback: İkizler on dört yaşında. On bir, Luca'nın hafta sonu kalkış saati.

questions.prompt: Who gets up late at the weekend?
questions.feedback: Luca uyumayı seviyor; hafta sonu on birde kalkıyor.
questions.evidence: He gets up at eleven at the weekend!

questions.feedback: Luca gitar çalıyor; basketbol Leo'nun sporu.
questions.evidence: He likes music and plays the guitar.

questions.feedback: Leo matematikte iyi; Luca İngilizce ve resimde.
